Use this guide to review the topics that are fair game for the midterm. It includes a topic checklist and quick references for key definitions, relational-algebra notation, PostgreSQL syntax, constraints, and ER diagrams.

[Download the study guide (PDF)](study-guides/csci340-midterm-study-guide.pdf){.btn .btn-primary download="csci340-midterm-study-guide.pdf"}

[Download the study guide (Word)](study-guides/csci340-midterm-study-guide.docx){.btn .btn-outline-primary download="csci340-midterm-study-guide.docx"}

## Exam format

The exam is **50 minutes** and **60 points**, with multiple-choice questions, short answers, and longer query and modeling questions. You may use **one standard letter-size sheet of notes, front and back**, for syntax or definitions.

## Topics

- The relational model, schemas and instances, keys, and referential integrity.
- Relational algebra: selection, projection, rename, products, joins, and set operations.
- Basic SQL queries, joins, duplicate handling, ordering, and `NULL`.
- Table definitions and changes, data types, and constraints, including `ON DELETE RESTRICT` and `ON DELETE CASCADE`. **DDL** means **Data Definition Language**, the SQL commands used to define or change database structures.
- ER diagrams, cardinality, participation, and basic relational mapping.

See Canvas for exam announcements and the [course schedule](schedule.qmd) for the review week.
